summary: Implemented the Tabs horizontal tab-bar feature without committing or running any tests or repository code. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with reactive private state, on_key, activation methods, find_tab_by_name, action_range_clicked, and an animated watcher); UnderlineBar now takes clickable_ranges before width and yields one rich Text with range_clicked click spans appended after the styled runs, with the zero-width early path preserved; Opacity merges the blended color into each segment's existing style so metadata survives; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; three new tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (existing tests untouched) and a new tests/test_tabs.py. The layout resolver needed no change because its edge protocol already has size, min_size (default 1), and fraction. Open points: the bar position maps full-list indexes to displayed tabs by name so duplicate names highlight the correct tab; letter search only runs for single-character keys; a zero-width label is treated as flexible by layout_resolve, an existing resolver behavior left unchanged; the Tabs constructor has no name or id parameter. The async on_key handler is untested because the repo has no async test harness. Nothing has been executed, so the test results are unverified.
